label: Iraqi buffalo

links.name: Wikipedia: List of water buffalo breeds

names.text: The Iraqi entry on the list gives the names Al Jamoose and Jimes (both meaning water buffalo), plus Dwab (Dauab) and Granish.

about.text: The Iraqi buffalo is a river-type water buffalo kept in Iraq for meat, milk and riding or work. Iraqi buffaloes are divided by habitat into marsh and urban types, and the urban river type is the larger and milkier of the two.

facts.v: Divided by habitat into a marsh type (Al Ahwar buffalo) and a city type; the urban river type is larger and milkier, with considerable colour variety.

gaps: Breed-level population: the only Iraqi figures found (209,160 head in 2017, citing FAO; about 285,000 in 2008) are for all buffalo in Iraq, not this breed, so left out. Milk yield: a 2023-2024 Dhi Qar study exists but its tables were garbled in search, so no figures were taken. Formation date and risk status: not found; the FAO DAD-IS entry was not reached through search.
